**Before you start:** this project runs on synthetic data only. Do not paste real patient data, resource bodies from a real system, credentials or tokens into this issue. If you think you have found a security issue, use the private route in `.github/SECURITY.md` (GitHub private vulnerability reporting) instead of this form.

**Commit or version, and Node version** (the verified runtime is Node 24.22.0)

**What you ran** (exact command, configuration with secrets removed, MCP client or host and its version, protocol era)

**What happened**

**What you expected**

**Minimal reproduction with synthetic data** (the bundled synthetic source, `npm run demo:source`, is preferred)

**Logs** (stderr only; the gateway never logs bodies, credentials or patient identifiers, so if you see any, say so and redact them)
